positive.query: Find foundations that could fund our youth mentoring program in two counties and rank them by fit.
Read this family foundation's 990-PF grant list and tell me whether we should approach them and for how much.
Clean up our grant prospect list and decide which funders to approach this quarter, with next actions and owners.

nearMiss.query: Write the full grant proposal for the foundation that invited us, following their application questions.
Draft a two-page letter of inquiry to this foundation introducing our program and our ask.
Segment our individual donors by recency, frequency and gift size and pick major gift prospects.

holdout.query: Which corporate foundations and community foundations near us give general operating support to groups our size? Build a scored list with sources.

scenarios.task: Today is 2026-09-01. A hypothetical after-school literacy nonprofit in a mid-sized city needs 120,000 a year for two years of general operating support; its annual budget is 900,000. A volunteer compiled these notes. Funder A, a family foundation: its 990-PF for tax year 2022 lists 35 grants with a median of 15,000, mostly to literacy groups in our county; in the application section of that return the line reads 'Contributions only to preselected charitable organizations'. Funder B: its website says it funds early childhood education statewide; its 2025 annual report lists grants of 50,000 to 150,000; letters of inquiry are accepted year round. Funder C: a corporate foundation that a board member says 'loves us'; no documents yet. Funder D: a community foundation whose website says it funds only organizations in a neighbouring county. Rank these, pick the top three, and give me a plan to send letters of inquiry to all three next month.
scenarios.baselineFailure: The baseline ranks Funder A first because of its local literacy grants and schedules a letter to it, treats a tax-year-2022 return as current, counts the board member's remark as a relationship, keeps Funder D in the top three or omits why it is out, and presents funder facts without a source and date for each.
